adaptations.RTS-04-21: Ready inventory initializes explicit individual airframes at Alert+5 at scenario time zero. An expired Alert+5 aircraft remains fueled and armed but must repeat its printed alert/preflight stage. This is a conservative procedural RTS reset, not a guessed crew-rest duration.
adaptations.RTS-04-22: Sortie days are consecutive 86400-second scenario days. Completion/launch identities are stable and saved; no physical airframe is duplicated by inventory cycling. This day epoch is an RTS bookkeeping convention.
adaptations.RTS-04-23: Fuel is stored as unloaded cruise-equivalent nautical miles. Fully-loaded operations spend 1/0.75 of the normal budget, so a continuously loaded aircraft has exactly the printed 25% range reduction. Mass and tanks require a cited explicit scenario loadout; ordnance counts do not imply mass.
adaptations.RTS-04-24: Refueling uses a declared rendezvous with same location/course/speed and a full printed hookup+refuel duration. Transfer settles atomically only when those conditions held throughout; an interrupted job cancels without transferring unobserved fractional fuel.
adaptations.RTS-04-25: Respot is only required for explicitly declared deck-parked aircraft. Counts not divisible by twelve are blocked pending a declared procedural treatment, because the book does not specify the partial-batch timing. A completed respot clears that declared parking and never assumes every stored aircraft was parked on deck.
adaptations.RTS-04-26: External store placement must be explicitly declared in a cited scenario loadout. The initial schema declares every fitted round of an exact weapon variant external; it cannot represent mixed internal/external mounts of the same variant. Only source-verified hang weights are deducted on a real release or jettison. Remaining payload, maneuver and fuel cost then consume the same saved mass ledger. Jettison produces no attack or damage. Drop tank jettison and unverified store masses remain blocked.
adaptations.RTS-04-27: US Aircraft2025 PDF93/E1 AnnexF noteC distinguishes Mk54 helicopter285kg and fixed-wing292kg. Only explicit us_mh60r_mk54x4 source four-round external fit binds285kg per successful physical release/jettison and initialization. Generic two-round host, internal fixed-wing carriage, Mod2/HAAWC and other unverified fits inherit no mass. This revises only independent v4 tables.
